# System packages required by the CI Python test suite.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for two things at once: the package
# list passed to apt-get, and the actions/cache key (via hashFiles). Editing it
# therefore invalidates the cache automatically — there is no second list to
# keep in sync.
#
# Why each package is here:
#   libsqlcipher-dev — requirements.txt pins sqlcipher3>=0.6.2, a C extension
#     that needs these headers to build. Without it pip install fails.
#   ffmpeg — three tests in test_streaming_tts_consolidation.py invoke the real
#     binary and fail with FileNotFoundError without it. Removing it is worse
#     than those three failures: FileNotFoundError subclasses OSError, and 8 of
#     the 9 production call sites catch OSError or bare Exception, so the rest
#     would silently take their error branch and CI would stay green while
#     testing materially less. Verified 2026-08-05, see Audiobook-Manager-27i.
#
# Blank lines and #-comments are stripped before the list reaches apt-get.
libsqlcipher-dev
ffmpeg
